title: GLASS Native Browser and Terminal Protocol
owner_statement: Full-time device-screen continuity in GLASS, C/C++ NDK browser, source-controlled shared-object finite gates, native binary inspection, source-backed OSS discovery, partitioned browser sessions, continuously checked scientific harness.
admission: Explicit user consent for each Android MediaProjection session; visible ongoing indicator; no stealth screen capture or bypass of FLAG_SECURE; no remote screen access before a separate paired/authorized endpoint exists.
source_inventory: Existing local experimental GLASS computational materials, C++/NDK project skeleton
Android official MediaProjection, foreground-service and NDK docs; Chromium WebView, Mozilla GeckoView/Fennec, LIEF, Wine/Box64 open-source references
constraints: All new work published on GLASS/main without force pushing
No direct claims of unrecoverable or forbidden screen pixels; represent gaps
Browsing through HTTPS only; glass:// is a local read-only operator overlay
Versioned C ABI; only packaged allowlisted .so modules; static PE/DLL signature inspection never executes Windows binaries
Experimental source does not claim built APK without actual Android SDK/NDK build
Independent scientific, implementation and deployment status fields
Keep other repositories untouched; old product names not used in new GLASS artifact names
recovery: Preserve durable source, actual test output, unsupported checks, and external build-blocker receipts. No automated ownership of the user's entire device, no cookie/session cloning.
epistemic: The user-defined calculus is an experimental framework; implementation reuse of established OSS documented, no novelty assertion.
